card.name: Decimal point in Clinical Pharmacology section numbers
card.fires_on: The period inside a section number like 12.3 or 12.6, right after "12" in a cross-reference to Clinical Pharmacology. It appears in bracketed "[see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)]" citations.

modes.label: Food or dosing cross-reference
modes.description: Period in (12.3) after a dosing sentence about taking with or without food.
modes.example: ELSIPITY is 2 mg orally once daily. • Swallow the tablet whole, with or without food [see Clinical Pharmacology (12<<.>>3) ] .

modes.label: Antibody cross-reference
modes.description: Period in (12.6) after a statement about anti-drug antibodies.
modes.example: had pre-existing IgG ADA [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.1 6.1 ) and Clinical Pharmacology ( 12<<.>>6 ) ] .

card.plain: It fires on the dot in the section number 12.3 or 12.6 when a label points the reader to the Clinical Pharmacology section.
